forbiddenOutcome.description: A pending output tries to join post-boundary state before its active pre-boundary frame reaches a safe point.

invariant: Active pre-boundary readers must quiesce before their outputs join post-boundary state.
title: unquiesced post-boundary output
whyFlowPulseMatters: The receipt-bound FlowPulse advances the rootfield epoch that forces old readers to reach a safe point.
